output.reason: The release note [ev-24365f012a2a] is only a title, but the linked PR [ev-eec17d754413] explains it. The subject is the EC2NodeClass conversion webhook for amiFamily and amiSelectorTerms (pkg/apis/v1/ec2nodeclass_conversion.go [ev-2c367dee52dc]). It makes two concrete behaviour changes. First, conversion now fails closed when the source amiFamily is Ubuntu. Second, conversion no longer creates an alias when amiFamily is non-custom and AMISelectorTerms are set. Together these define which EC2NodeClasses are exposed (Ubuntu, or non-custom family with selector terms) and what happens to them (Ubuntu conversion is rejected; the selector terms are kept with no alias added). The PR does not say exactly what the old Ubuntu conversion produced.
